_source: Client ingredient cards and the '8 Body Systems' sheet (WhatsApp, 7 Nov 2026). Text copied from the cards. 'confirm' lists conflicts the client still has to settle.

ingredients.name: Vitamin A
ingredients.summary: Vitamin A (Retinyl Palmitate) is a stable, highly bioavailable form of Vitamin A that supports healthy vision, skin health, immunity and overall cell function.

ingredients.name: Vitamin B1
ingredients.summary:
Thiamine Hydrochloride is a stable and highly bioavailable form of Vitamin B1 (Thiamine), a vital water-soluble vitamin that plays a key role in converting the food you eat into usable energy.

Vitamin B1 supports normal energy metabolism by helping your body break down carbohydrates into energy (ATP), keeping you active, alert and mentally focused.

Additionally, it contributes to the healthy function of the nervous system, supports heart function, and plays a role in maintaining normal cognitive function and overall vitality.

ingredients.name: Vitamin B2
ingredients.summary:
Riboflavin-5-Phosphate is the active, coenzyme form of Vitamin B2 (Riboflavin) that is readily utilized by the body, offering better bioavailability and direct participation in key energy-producing reactions.

Vitamin B2 helps convert the food you eat into energy (ATP), supports normal metabolism of carbohydrates, fats and proteins, and plays an important role in maintaining healthy skin, eyes and mucous membranes.

Additionally, it contributes to antioxidant defense by supporting glutathione recycling, helps maintain red blood cells, and works with other B-vitamins to support overall energy, vitality and cellular health.

ingredients.name: Vitamin B3
ingredients.summary:
Niacinamide (Vitamin B3) is a stable, well-tolerated and highly bioavailable form of Vitamin B3 that supports energy production, skin health and metabolic function.

Vitamin B3 helps convert the food you eat into usable energy (ATP), supports healthy cholesterol levels, and contributes to the normal function of the nervous system and digestive system.

Additionally, it promotes healthy, resilient skin by supporting the skin barrier and reducing oxidative stress, helps maintain cellular repair and DNA health, and supports overall cardiometabolic wellness and vitality.

ingredients.name: Pantothenic Acid
ingredients.summary:
Pantothenic Acid (Vitamin B5) is a key B-vitamin that helps convert the food you eat into usable energy and supports the synthesis of important hormones and coenzymes.

Vitamin B5 supports energy metabolism, reduces tiredness and fatigue, and helps maintain healthy skin, hair and immune function.

Additionally, it plays a vital role in the production of Coenzyme A (CoA), which is essential for the metabolism of carbohydrates, fats and proteins, contributing to overall vitality and daily performance.

ingredients.name: Vitamin B6
ingredients.summary:
Pyridoxal-5-Phosphate (P5P) is the active, coenzyme form of Vitamin B6, which is readily utilized by the body and plays a crucial role in protein, amino acid and neurotransmitter metabolism.

Vitamin B6 supports the production of key brain chemicals such as serotonin, dopamine and GABA, which help regulate mood, focus and healthy sleep. It also supports immune function, red blood cell formation and the metabolism of homocysteine, contributing to heart and vascular health.

Additionally, it aids in the metabolism of carbohydrates, proteins and fats, supports hormonal balance, and helps reduce fatigue, promoting overall energy, mental well-being and daily performance.

ingredients.name: Folate
ingredients.confirm: 113.31% of 200 mcg implies an RDA of about 176 mcg; ICMR-NIN 2020 gives 300 mcg for adults (about 67%).
ingredients.summary:
Folate (Vitamin B9) is an essential B-vitamin that supports DNA synthesis, cell division and the formation of healthy red blood cells.

Folate helps in the production of new cells, supports healthy brain and nerve function, and plays a vital role during periods of rapid cell growth such as pregnancy.

Additionally, it works with Vitamins B6 and B12 to help maintain normal homocysteine levels, supporting heart and vascular health and overall cellular well-being.

ingredients.name: Vitamin B12
ingredients.summary:
Cyanocobalamin is a stable and effective form of Vitamin B12 that helps in the production of healthy red blood cells, supports nerve function and plays a key role in energy metabolism.

Vitamin B12 helps convert the food you eat into usable energy, supports brain and memory function, and maintains the health of the nervous system.

Additionally, it works with folate and Vitamin B6 to regulate homocysteine levels, supporting heart health and overall metabolic wellness.

ingredients.name: Vitamin C
ingredients.summary:
Ascorbic Acid is a pure, fast-absorbing form of Vitamin C that strengthens immunity, boosts collagen production, and enhances iron absorption with high bioavailability, meaning it is quickly absorbed and efficiently utilized by the body.

Vitamin C is an essential, water-soluble vitamin with potent antioxidant properties. It helps protect cells from oxidative stress and free radical damage, supports the normal function of the immune system, and plays a key role in the formation of collagen for healthy skin, gums, bones and connective tissues.

Additionally, Vitamin C supports wound healing, improves non-heme iron absorption, aids in energy metabolism (carnitine synthesis), enhances endothelial and vascular health by maintaining healthy blood vessels, and helps in the regeneration of other antioxidants such as Vitamin E and glutathione, contributing to overall cellular defense, vitality and well-being.

ingredients.name: Vitamin D3
ingredients.summary:
Vitamin D3 (Cholecalciferol) is the natural and highly bioavailable form of Vitamin D that helps the body absorb calcium, supports strong bones and teeth, and plays a key role in immune health.

It helps maintain optimal calcium levels, supports muscle strength and function, and contributes to overall immunity and metabolic wellness.

Additionally, it plays an important role in mood regulation, energy levels and overall well-being.

ingredients.name: Vitamin E
ingredients.summary:
DL-alpha-Tocopherol Succinate is a stable, bioavailable form of Vitamin E, an essential, fat-soluble antioxidant that helps protect cells from oxidative stress and free radical damage.

Vitamin E supports immune function, skin health, and healthy aging by maintaining the integrity of cell membranes and promoting cellular defense.

Additionally, it contributes to heart and cardiovascular health by helping to prevent oxidative damage to blood vessels, supports brain and cognitive function, and works synergistically with Vitamin C and other antioxidants to enhance overall antioxidant protection, vitality, and well-being.

ingredients.name: Vitamin K2
ingredients.summary:
Vitamin K2 (All-Trans MK-7) is a highly bioavailable form of Vitamin K2 that directs calcium to your bones and teeth, and away from your arteries.

It helps build and maintain strong bones, supports cardiovascular health and overall long-term bone and vascular health.

ingredients.name: Choline
ingredients.confirm: Two cards say 30 mg, one says 250 mg.
ingredients.summary:
Choline (as Choline Bitartrate) is an essential nutrient that supports brain health, memory, focus and overall cognitive performance.

It helps in the production of acetylcholine, a key neurotransmitter involved in learning, mood and mental clarity.

Additionally, choline supports healthy liver function and the metabolism of fats, contributing to overall brain, liver and metabolic health.

ingredients.name: Zinc
ingredients.confirm: The card uses 50 mg/day as the zinc RDA; ICMR-NIN 2020 gives about 17 mg (men) / 13.2 mg (women).
ingredients.summary: Zinc (as Zinc Citrate) is an essential trace mineral that supports immune function, wound healing, tissue repair and overall cellular health.

ingredients.name: Copper
ingredients.summary: Copper (as Copper Citrate) is an essential trace mineral that supports iron metabolism, connective tissue health, immune function and antioxidant defence.

ingredients.name: Selenium
ingredients.confirm: The card says 55 mcg; the 8 Body Systems sheet says 40 mcg.
ingredients.summary:
Selenium (as Selenomethionine) is an essential trace mineral in a highly bioavailable form that acts as a powerful antioxidant and supports immune, thyroid and cellular health.

It helps protect cells from oxidative stress, supports normal thyroid hormone function and contributes to overall immunity.

Additionally, selenium plays a key role in maintaining healthy hair, skin and nails.

ingredients.name: Iodine
ingredients.summary: Iodine (as Potassium Iodide) is an essential trace mineral that supports normal thyroid hormone production, which helps regulate metabolism, energy and overall well-being.

ingredients.name: Chromium
ingredients.summary:
Chromium (as Chromium Picolinate) is an essential trace mineral that helps the body use insulin more efficiently, supporting healthy blood sugar levels and macronutrient (carbohydrate, fat and protein) metabolism.

It helps improve insulin sensitivity, supports steady energy release and contributes to overall metabolic health.

ingredients.name: Manganese
ingredients.summary:
Manganese (as Manganese Sulfate) is an essential trace mineral that acts as a cofactor for key enzymes involved in bone formation, energy metabolism and antioxidant defense.

It helps maintain strong and healthy bones, supports collagen formation for healthy joints and connective tissues, and aids in macronutrient metabolism (carbohydrates, proteins and fats) for sustained energy.

Additionally, manganese supports the body's natural antioxidant system, helping protect cells from oxidative stress.

ingredients.name: Boron
ingredients.summary:
Boron (as Boron Citrate) is a beneficial trace mineral that supports bone health, hormone balance and nutrient metabolism.

It helps in the proper utilization of calcium, magnesium and vitamin D, supporting stronger bones and healthy joints.

Additionally, boron may support healthy testosterone levels (in men), cognitive function and overall metabolic health.

ingredients.name: Phosphorus
ingredients.summary:
Phosphorus (as Tricalcium Phosphate) is an essential mineral that works with calcium to build and maintain strong bones and teeth.

It helps in energy production (ATP), supports cell function and plays a key role in muscle and nerve health.

ingredients.name: Silica
ingredients.summary:
Silica (as Silicon Dioxide) is a naturally occurring form of silicon, an essential trace mineral that supports the structure and strength of connective tissues.

It helps maintain healthy hair, skin and nails, and supports collagen and bone health.

Additionally, silica contributes to overall connective tissue integrity and musculoskeletal health.

ingredients.name: CoQ10
ingredients.summary:
CoQ10 (Coenzyme Q10) is a powerful antioxidant naturally present in the body that plays a key role in energy production at the cellular level.

It helps convert food into usable energy (ATP), supports heart health, brain function and overall stamina.

Additionally, CoQ10 helps reduce oxidative stress, supports healthy ageing and promotes overall cellular health.

ingredients.name: MSM
ingredients.summary:
MSM (Methylsulfonylmethane) is a natural source of bioavailable sulfur, an essential mineral that supports joint, skin, hair and connective tissue health.

It helps maintain joint comfort and mobility, reduces exercise-related inflammation, and supports the body's natural recovery process.

Additionally, MSM contributes to the production of collagen and keratin, promoting healthy skin, stronger hair and nails.

ingredients.name: Astragalus Membranaceus Extract
ingredients.summary:
Astragalus Membranaceus Extract is a traditional adaptogenic herb, known for its immune-supporting and vitality-enhancing properties.

It helps strengthen the body's natural defense, supports cellular health and energy, and promotes long-term stamina and resilience.

ingredients.name: Rhodiola Rosea Extract
ingredients.summary:
Rhodiola Rosea Extract is a powerful adaptogenic herb, traditionally used to help the body adapt to physical and mental stress.

It helps reduce fatigue, enhance mental focus and endurance, and support overall resilience and performance.

ingredients.name: Sunfiber® PHGG
ingredients.summary:
Sunfiber® PHGG is a clinically studied, gentle prebiotic fiber that nourishes good gut bacteria and supports a healthy digestive system.

It helps improve gut balance, regularity and nutrient absorption with high tolerance and no bloating.

ingredients.name: Inulin
ingredients.summary:
Inulin is a natural prebiotic fibre that helps nourish beneficial gut bacteria and supports a healthy digestive system.

It helps improve gut health, supports digestion, and contributes to overall immunity and well-being.

ingredients.name: Bromelain
ingredients.summary: Bromelain is a natural proteolytic enzyme derived from pineapple that supports healthy digestion, nutrient breakdown and post-activity recovery.
